"""ADB and usbmuxd sync wire-format validation."""
import base64, plistlib, struct, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import protocols
from protocols import signature, parse_sync, read_adb_response

def adb(command,arg0,arg1,body):
    return struct.pack('<6I',command,arg0,arg1,len(body),
                       sum(body)&0xffffffff,command^0xffffffff)+body

def frame(body):
    return struct.pack('>I',len(body))+body

fails=[]
def check(label,got,want):
    if got!=want:
        fails.append(label); print('FAIL',label,'got',got,'want',want)

# ADB CNXN
body=b'host::zgrab2'
p=adb(0x4e584e43,0x01000000,4096,body)
check('cnxn',signature('adb',p),('CNXN','1.0.0','host::zgrab2'))
check('cnxn version 0x00112233',signature('adb',adb(0x4e584e43,0x00112233,1,b'')),
      ('CNXN','17.34.51',''))
bad=bytearray(p); bad[16]^=1   # corrupt checksum
check('cnxn bad checksum',signature('adb',bytes(bad)),None)
check('cnxn trailing',signature('adb',p+b'x'),None)

bad=bytearray(p); bad[20]^=1   # corrupt magic
check('cnxn bad magic',signature('adb',bytes(bad)),None)
check('cnxn length too big',signature('adb',struct.pack('<6I',0x4e584e43,1,1,65536,0,

check('short header',signature('adb',b'\x00'*23),None)
